snippet.title: [Pre-alpha] Reval 1420 Teaser
snippet.description:
Reval 1420 is an upcoming videogame set in medieval Tallinn. You arrive to collect a dead man's estate and end up dying in his house. 

🖥️ Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5610020/Reval_1420/?utm_source=video&utm_medium=youtube&utm_campaign=teaser

The first 10 minutes of the playable prototype are ready: landing in Reval's harbour and seeking out your host in the city. This teaser video shows what's going on in the city as you arrive.

Credits: https://www.reval1420.eu/credits. Building 3D model and elevation data: Republic of Estonia Land and Spatial Development Board 2026. Licence: https://geoportaal.maaruum.ee/opendata-licence.

#Reval1420 #indiegame #medievalhistory #hanseaticleague #tallinn #estonia #eesti #gamedev
